properties.name: (b) A /jot skill
properties.statement:
A person can jot down an idea, a question or a "remember to" in one breath: /jot or /note plus a sentence. It is recorded in their own words with no questions asked and nothing worked through at that moment. It comes back later to be brainstormed, captured as intent, or dropped.

It widens /log-issue's tiny capture, which today is for issues only and says "Not for an idea", to take ideas and reminders too, under a word a non-technical person would type. /log-issue folds into it as one of its shortcuts (settled below), and like /log-issue today:
- it lands on the thing it names, found by search, or on the project;
- it is listed at the boundary until settled.

Anthony, 2026-09-24, relaying his brother's use of flo2 ("I can just start dumping ideas about my shop into it and it's storing them"): "this idea to quickly log into a AI chat, quickly jot down an idea, then come back later to really address brainstorm it or see how it fits into the design. Sometimes the crazy ideas come when you're in the shower or driving down the road or at an event or restaurant and you don't necessarily want to spend time working through the idea at that moment - just want to capture the thought and then come back to it later."

He kept "(b) A /jot skill" as intent, from flo2's brainstorm dec:idea-jot-it-down-now-work-it-through-later. These stay recorded there as considered:
- using /log-issue as it is;
- a brainstorm quick mode;
- a per-person inbox for jots with no design;
- showing unsorted jots on flo2's account page.

SETTLED by Anthony, 2026-09-24 ("go with your recommendation for /jot, /log-issue, /note"): ONE MECHANISM, THREE WORDS.
- /jot is the one skill. It records the sentence in the person's words, asks nothing, and lists it until settled.
- /log-issue becomes a shortcut into /jot that tags the note as an ISSUE. /note is a shortcut that tags it as an IDEA. A bare /jot leaves it untagged.
- The word the person types carries the kind, so nothing is ever asked at capture. That is the objection reflow2 recorded against a general door that asks "which kind is this?".
- One list of open notes, each tagged, so there is never a second list to check.
- Settling follows the tag:
  - an issue goes toward root-cause, then a finding with a cause, a planned check, or dropped with a word;
  - an idea goes toward brainstorm, capture-intent, or dropped with a word;
  - an untagged jot is sorted by the person at the time.
- /log-issue keeps working as it does today (Anthony's work use and its documentation), so nothing existing breaks.

His reasoning: "/log-issue really is about seeing issues when you're actively developing something, but similar in concept that it is something to come back to later when you can sort through an issue. /jot would just be the more generalized version of that."
